CustomField.description: When the household merge after a Contact merge (orphaned household or household with members) runs, choose the surviving household with the Account keep record rules instead of always keeping the kept contact's household. The kept contact moves into the surviving household when the rules prefer the other one. Falls back to the kept contact's household when no rule singles out an Account or when a kept contact has more than one household to merge.
